rationale: The user requires repeatable statistically significant improvements and specified no minimum percentage. The original exploratory triage cutoff can discard a smaller repeatable effect. Authorize the already-planned fresh confirmations to evaluate that possibility; do not reinterpret the failed discovery or use it for confirmation inference.
remaining_authority: Separate exact stage authority after independent discovery validity review.
requirements: Independent discovery validity audit must pass before execution.
Each of the two fresh eight-pair blocks must independently pass the existing all-wins and 99% lower-bound-above-0.1% criteria.
No retry or sample extension after a valid confirmation failure; any collection failure stops pending review without comparative effects.
No discovery observations enter either confirmation or their statistical estimates.
All native endpoint, regression-blocker, output, restoration and publication-availability rules remain unchanged.
Any publication must disclose the failed original0.5% triage gate and this after-discovery, pre-confirmation continuation amendment.
Nominal bootstrap/sign inference retains its existing sampling and scheduling-dependence assumptions; balanced order alone does not establish independence.
